label: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper
title: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper: Ratings, Text & Replies
metaDescription: Export Trustpilot reviews from company links, websites or brand names: rating, full text, dates, company reply, reviewer country and verification.
intro: Give it Trustpilot company links, websites or brand names and get their reviews: rating, full text, dates, the company's reply, reviewer country and verification status, plus the company's profile. No login.
useCases: Benchmark your rating and reply rate against competitors
Find recurring complaints in a market
Monitor new reviews on a schedule

faq.a: There are no per-review or per-company charges; a run only uses your own Apify platform credits, which the free Apify plan covers for small jobs.

faq.q: Can I scrape all reviews of a big company?
faq.a: It reads a company's review history in depth, combines everything without duplicates and reports how many matching reviews it read, for example 800 of 834.

faq.q: Can I filter by rating, language or keyword?
faq.a: Yes, with the same filters as Trustpilot's "Filter by" panel: rating, verified, replies, date posted, top mentions, keyword search and language.

faq.q: What do I put in the input?
faq.a: Trustpilot links from any country site, company websites (example.com) or brand names, one per line. Reviewer profile links work too.

faq.q: Do I get the TrustScore and company details?
faq.a: Yes. One company row per company: TrustScore, rating split, review counts per language, reply rate and speed, categories, published contact details and Trustpilot's AI summary.

officialApi: Trustpilot's APIs are for businesses with a paid Trustpilot plan, mainly to manage and show their own reviews, and need API keys. This actor reads the reviews anyone can see on Trustpilot, for any company.
